g.text: Every dollar's path through Puddl3 — from an employer's bank account to a worker's wallet, and from
withheld taxes to the IRS — traced end to end.
Solid arrows are money moving. The clock-out event is where each payment splits in two — net pay continues down to the worker,
withheld tax branches into the trust pool. The teal paths are where Puddl3's own revenue accumulates; the amber path is the
single highest-priority open legal question in the whole model.
